annotation.title_clean: Projeto de Lei nº 1797/2024 - Estabelece normas gerais para o desenvolvimento, implementação e uso responsável de sistemas de Inteligência Artificial
annotation.title_en: Bill No. 1797/2024 - Establishes general rules for the responsible development, implementation and use of Artificial Intelligence systems
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Câmara dos Deputados (Dep. Dr. Allan Garcês)
annotation.summary_en: Brazilian Chamber of Deputies bill setting general rules for responsible AI development and use to protect human rights. It bans discriminatory and manipulative AI and certain biometric categorisation, imposes strict liability on providers, grants contestation rights, empowers the ANPD to classify risks, and creates an inter-ministerial National AI Council.
key_provisions_or_claims: Principles: human rights, human participation, traceability, transparency, AI-content labelling
Bans AI for discrimination, subliminal or manipulative techniques, and biometric categorisation inferring race, beliefs or orientation
Strict liability of AI providers or operators for property or moral damage regardless of system autonomy
Right to contest and request review of significant AI decisions
ANPD empowered to regulate, sanction, and classify AI risk levels; National AI Council (CNIA) created
